title: CmdPal: Support virtual adapters in Performance Monitor

confidence.rationale: Exact current caller, constructor sampling, and live/default filter reads establish the lifecycle; the replacement changes comments only.

proposed_comments.title: Document when the network settings source must be attached
proposed_comments.body:
### Document when the network settings source must be attached

**Severity:** `low` (non-blocking contract documentation)

Please make the existing initialization order explicit here: attach the live settings source before creating network widgets so their first sample uses the user's filters. `NetworkStats` samples during construction, and an unconfigured snapshot provider uses the default filters. Later reads use the current settings values, not a frozen configuration.

The current command-provider constructor already configures the shared provider before enabling widgets. This documents that correct lifecycle for future callers; it does not allege a current startup failure or request a dependency-injection redesign, one-time guard, or cache.

```suggestion
    // Set the live settings source before network widgets are created so the first sample uses the user's filters.
    // Subsequent samples read the current settings rather than an immutable options snapshot.
```
